_help: Quotes shown on the home and Work with me pages. Each one is filled with SAMPLE text (marked "sample": true) so you can see the layout and simply replace it. For each real quote: replace "quote", "name" and "role", optionally add a square "photo" (upload it to assets/media first, at least 200 px) and a short "result" tag, then delete the "sample" line. Only publish quotes people have agreed to. Samples show a "Sample · replace" tag, and they are hidden automatically when show_placeholders is false, so they can never go live by accident.
heading: What the people I’ve worked with say
